title: Asana secret layouts outside the exact-header claim
summary: A credential-shaped value under a longer X-Hook-Secret header name and a bare unlabelled string.
rationale: The bounded claim is the exact header. A longer header name is another header and a bare string has no carrier, so nothing settles whether either is a credential.

expectation.rationale: No outcome is asserted: the layouts are frozen as unsupported variants of the exact-header claim.

sources.supports: Included in the header of that `POST` request from Asana is an `X-Hook-Secret`. This value serves as a shared secret that both Asana and the receiving server store.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
